data.narrative:
Dominion Dynamics is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Eliot Pence (former Anduril International leader, 2018–2022) and Mitch Carkner (ex-CEO Decisive, Amazon/IBM veteran, Canadian Forces background). The company has raised $18M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, plus 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-Progression, anchoring on the $18M raised as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage, yields $45M. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range of $125M–$1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range of $38M–$460M, with a median of $222M. The material gap between stage-progression ($45M) and peer-median ($400M) reflects uncertainty around which peer cohort most closely matches Dominion's positioning and growth trajectory. Key uncertainties include revenue or ARR data, product maturity, customer concentration, and the degree to which peer valuations reflect post-money or pre-money conventions. Additional diligence on near-term milestones and market traction is warranted to narrow this range.
